ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels; surface is dominantly dark with localized high-contrast markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous clusters localized at the distal tips; scattered high-contrast circular and linear filaments distributed across the upper half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 130 degrees and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge, with greatest amplitude at the distal thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge, tapering significantly toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast rings (white on black); one prominent on the central left lobe, several smaller clusters and one large ring on the upper-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense networks of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) concentrated on the upper medial edges and near the trailing boundary of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized textured clusters of high-intensity pixels at the extreme distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization; extensive tooth rake scarring across the visible surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique white 'ring-within-a-ring' marking on the upper right lobe near the trailing edge.
